title: I Posted the Cafeteria-Card Photo After They Ran Snacks on My Balance

parts.text: I posted the card photo at 12:19 p.m. with three snack lines I did not tap. Till lead Remy said balances were atmosphere. I was thirty, analyst, standing in a line that made me look like I owned the chips. The ledger said MY CODE. The snacks were his. I photographed the ledger, the chips, and Remy's name on the till. Then I left the still on the board they moderated. Remy laughed until payroll asked for the photo. The snacks reversed. Remy code-dates the till now. A balance is only a number until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: Three snacks ran on my cafeteria code — Part 1/1
social.description: Ledger, chips, a till name. Payroll asked for the photo. Has a card ever fed someone else's break?
